Hi Product Hunt,

Claire Mail brings Gmail, Google Calendar and Apple Reminders together in one app for Mac and iPhone. [...] Report

Claire Mail

Maker

@tamilselvi\_ramasamy2 That's right :) And it all works seamlessly. Claire was built to help you get through your busy day without having to scroll endlessly. Check out the triage feature for mail and reminders. Thanks for giving it a try!

Report

Giving email and reminders the same card-by-card treatment makes sense. It turns clearing the daily list into a series of small decisions.

Report

Claire Mail

Maker

@oleksii\_sekundant Thank you! That was the idea. Email and reminders both pile up into one long list you keep scrolling past, so I wanted them to feel the same: one card, one decision, next. Would love to hear how the reminders side feels once you try it.

Report [...] Your mail stays in Gmail. AI is optional: Apple Intelligence runs on the device with no key, or use your own key. Ask Claire suggests a step and waits for you to tap it.

It’s free during beta. The Mac app is a notarized download, and the iPhone app is on TestFlight.

What would keep you from switching from your current mail app? That’s the feedback we need most.

Report

does the inbox triage run locally or does email content get sent off to a server somewhere

Report

Claire Mail

Maker

@jaewon\_seo Thanks for asking. Triage runs on your device: it's your Gmail, loaded straight from Google into the app on your device, and swiping archives, snoozes or pins through Gmail directly. No AI is involved in Triage, and nothing from it goes to our servers.
